# Requirements Catalog

## Functional Requirements

| ID | Title | User Story | Priority | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-001 | Submit intake request | As an analyst, I want to submit an intake request so that work can begin. | High | Open | input/brs.md |
| FR-002 | Track status | As an analyst, I want to track request status so that I can monitor progress. | High | Open | input/brs.md |
| FR-003 | Review request | As a supervisor, I want to review a request so that I can approve or reject it. | High | Open | input/brs.md |
| FR-004 | Score request | As a scoring service, I want to score a request so that priority can be assigned. | Medium | Open | input/brs.md |
| FR-005 | Offer resolution | As an analyst, I want to provide an offer so that the request can move forward. | Medium | Open | input/brs.md |
| FR-006 | Administer workflow | As an administrator, I want to manage workflow settings so that the process stays compliant. | Medium | Open | input/brs.md |

## Non-Functional Requirements

| ID | Title | Requirement | Category | Priority | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
